note:
Round 4's §B on the climb's lower rung. Every row reaches the surface by a PRESS: the Analysis tab, Analyze, and then the disclosure — the tab has no address and the disclosure is local state.

PRECONDITION: a server running with ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED=true.

FIXTURES are two brews on local-dev owned by the e2e account: PATH_DECK (d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000d5c1: five game changers beside Sanguine Bond and Exquisite Blood, so it reads Optimized or cEDH and every target below it has something to name) and PATH_BLOCKED_DECK (d0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000d5c2: four game changers under Braids, Cabal Minion, itself a game changer, so Core and Exhibition are out of reach of removals and Upgraded is not). Pressing a target chip writes nothing, so every state here is re-photographable.

NOT PHOTOGRAPHED: u6, the satisfied path, which the lower rung cannot reach — its targets are every bracket below the reading's floor, where something always has to go. And u8, both halves of a combo in the command zone, which is in the unit tests: it wants a commander pair that Spellbook records as a two-card combo, and this sheet carries no such fixture.

NO `shares` BLOCK: one mount.

rows.label: /decks/[id] Analysis — the lower rung, To downgrade your deck, with its closed disclosure
/decks/[id] Analysis — the path open at Upgraded: target chips, any two of these five
/decks/[id] Analysis — the path at Core: every game changer named, the combo broken by either half
/decks/[id] Analysis — blocked at Core: the commander on a dashed edge, and the nearest target that removals reach
